Installation

Get started with Widgets#

Widgets works by scanning all of your templates for class names, generating the corresponding styles and writing them to a static file.

Install the plugin

Install widgets and its build plugin with npm, then add the plugin to your build configuration.

Configure it

Add the plugin to the plugins array in your configuration file and restart the development server so the change takes effect.
